answer: A collateralized reputation bond makes every identity post a refundable stake that matures only through real work done in the open. First, an agent locks 50 POA for 30 days before trading. Second, a spiral of three checks: 10 verified jobs, 3 peer attestations, a 7-day public review. Third, upheld fraud slashes the full 50 POA and severs the thread to its vouching accounts. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 50,000 POA and locks each fake 30 days before it can trade once. Like an orchard fruiting only after seasons of tending, such a reputation cannot be faked overnight.
